title: Federation Trust Document (Wakir V-908 0.1.0)
description: JSON Schema for a Wakir Federation Trust Document (FTD). Defines the bilateral trust artefact a verifier consults to accept AIP documents issued by a peer organisation. Schema follows V-908 spec section 2.1; signature procedure follows section 2.2 (deep-copy minus document_signature, JCS-canonicalise, SHA-256, Ed25519).

wakir_ftd.description: Schema version. V-908 Phase-1b uses 0.1.0; bumps follow the Wirelang schema-versioning policy.

id.description: FTD-doc identifier. Phase-1b accepts only the 'did:web:<host>:ftd:v<N>' form per V-908 spec section 3.1.

domain.description: Human-readable peer organisation name. Matched against the AIP fetch URL host per V-908 section 4.1 step 4 (FTDDomainMismatchError on mismatch).

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this FTD-doc generation was issued.

expires.description: RFC 3339 expiry timestamp. Verifier MUST reject FTD-doc whose expires is before the verifier clock (section 4.6 FTDExpiredError).

ftd_root_pubkey.description: Ed25519 root public key, 32 bytes lowercase hex. The on-document copy of the FTD root; document_signature is verified against this key.

issuer_keys.description: AIP-issuer keys this FTD accepts. Each entry carries its own valid_from/valid_until window so individual issuer keys can be retired without rotating the FTD-doc.

kid.description: Key identifier, stable inside this FTD-doc.

alg.description: Signing algorithm. Phase-1b restricts to Ed25519; secp256k1 issuer keys are out of V-908 scope (Wakir AIP signatures are Ed25519 by Phase-1a convention).

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes lowercase hex.

purpose.description: Purpose binding. Phase-1b accepts only 'biscuit-root'; the AIP-doc cross-check (section 4.1 step 7) demands purpose match.

valid_until.description: RFC 3339 upper bound, or null for an open-ended window.

endpoints.description: Discovery hint for resolving AIP documents inside this domain (section 3.2). Optional in Phase-1b.

anchor.description: DNS anchor binding the FTD-doc fingerprint to peer DNS control (section 3.4).

kind.description: Phase-1b anchor kind. Phase-2 may add additional kinds.

host.description: DNS query name, including the '_wakir-ftd.' label (section 3.4).

fingerprint_sha256.description: Lowercase hex of SHA-256(JCS(body without document_signature)).
